The component is the Settings -> notifications GlassPanel with four stacked sections (browser-notification permission flow L69-130, browser-tab signals L132-151, notification sounds L153-240) plus the categoryFallback() label helper L246-263; all are preserved in the native port.

Imports L1-16 ported: react useState (L1) -> react useState (+ useCallback/useMemo/useSyncExternalStore for the local store shims); react-i18next useTranslation('settings') (L2,19) -> native-safe useNativeTranslationFallback t(key, default, params?) with {{token}} interpolation (the NotificationChannelsView/AIRestorePanel precedent), preserving every key + default + the 'settings' namespace intent. @/components/ui GlassPanel/IconBox/Button/Badge/Toggle/Slider (L3): GlassPanel uses the existing native primitive (style={styles.card} = p-6 padding 24 + space-y-5 gap 20); IconBox uses the native parity port (color='cyan', string glyph child auto-tinted); Button/Badge/Toggle/Slider have no native ports so minimal native-safe equivalents are reproduced locally (the NotificationChannelsView precedent) -- Toggle -> Pressable switch (track+thumb, accessibilityRole='switch'+accessibilityState.checked), Slider -> -/+ stepper over a filled track (no @react-native-community/slider dependency, the SmartChargePage precedent), Badge -> success chip, Button -> primary/ghost Pressable with optional glyph. @/components/motion FadeIn (L4) -> local View wrapper (delay 0.13 accepted+ignored = reduced-motion final state, the NotificationChannelsView FadeIn stand-in).

Browser-only hooks reduced explicitly (contract rule 7). @/hooks/useWebPush (L5,20): the browser Notification API + Web Push (VAPID/PushManager/service workers) have no React Native equivalent and no native push module is wired, so useWebPush is reproduced locally returning isSupported:false, permission:'denied', no-op requestPermission. permission is typed as the full NotificationPermission union so the L86/L95/L100 permission==='default'/'granted'/'denied' comparisons stay valid even though only the !notificationsSupported branch renders -- exactly how a browser without Notification support behaves. @/hooks/useNotificationListener (L6,21): its SSE subscription + browser Notification firing are browser-only; the native stand-in keeps only the { prefs, setPrefs } WebPushPreferences contract (alerts/exportStatus, default both true) consumed at L21,114-122, in-memory (no localStorage). WebPushPreferences (L6,15-18 of the source hook) is preserved verbatim and re-exported.

@/api/hooks/useSettings useSettings/useSaveSettings (L7,22-23) imported from the already-ported native parity hooks mirror (../../../api/hooks/useSettings); AppSettings type reused so updateTabSetting's full-replace mutate payload stays typed.

@/lib/notificationSound (L8-14) reproduced as a native-safe in-memory reactive store: NOTIFICATION_SOUND_CATEGORIES (L9, the 7-tuple) + NotificationSoundCategory type + NotificationSoundPrefs shape + DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_SOUND_PREFS (master:false, perCategory seed, volume:0.6) + clamp + useNotificationSoundPrefs (useSyncExternalStore, subscribe/getSnapshot) + setNotificationSoundPrefs (L10, partial patch, shallow perCategory merge, volume clamp [0,1], unchanged-patch skips notify so getSnapshot stays referentially stable) ported from the web store (notificationSound L23-195). localStorage + window 'storage'-event persistence is dropped (no Web Storage on native -- documented). playNotificationSound (L14, notificationSound L364-406) keeps the web pref-gate ordering (master_off -> category_off -> volume_zero) but the WebAudio AudioContext is unavailable on native, so a play the web would have performed resolves to { played:false, reason:'no_audio_context' } -- which is exactly what handleTestSound L48-50 branches on. @/lib/cn cn() (L15): the one conditional class !soundPrefs.master && 'opacity-60' (L194) -> conditional styles.categoryRowDisabled. lucide-react Bell/Volume2/Play (L16) -> decorative AppText glyphs (BELL/VOLUME/PLAY) the sibling-port way.
